new_exact_v1_reviews.title: FusionRCG: Orchestrating Recursive Computation Graphs across GPU Memory Hierarchies
new_exact_v1_reviews.problem: Evaluating high-dimensional integrals via deep hierarchical recurrences is a dominant cost in quantum chemistry.
new_exact_v1_reviews.old_path_and_changed_constraint: 传统 GPU 优化通常在固定依赖图上调整指令顺序或拆分 kernel；当递归计算图的同时存活中间量超过每线程寄存器预算时，spill 会把原本 compute-bound 的计算推向 HBM memory-bound，单纯调度固定 DAG 已不足以解决问题。
new_exact_v1_reviews.mechanism_and_ownership: We present FusionRCG, a framework that jointly optimizes computation graph structure and GPU memory mapping.
new_exact_v1_reviews.evaluation_contract: 作者在 NVIDIA A100-80GB、CUDA 12.4 上与 GPU4PySCF 比较：单卡覆盖不同分子规模及 cc-pVDZ/VTZ/VQZ 基组，报告最高 3.09x、cc-pVQZ 平均 2.4x 的单次 SCF iteration 加速；并在 8 节点 64 张 A100 上对 Ubiquitin/cc-pVTZ 报告 75% parallel efficiency。数字只适用于论文披露的量化化学 workload、baseline 与硬件。
new_exact_v1_reviews.proof_and_nonproof: Evidence is author-reported exact-v1 mechanism/evaluation evidence. It does not establish cross-model, cross-hardware, cross-workload or production generality unless those conditions are explicitly named above.
new_exact_v1_reviews.tradeoffs_and_failure_modes: 方案以专用图生成和两级 kernel 路由换取更低 peak liveness：低阶图尽量保持 register-only，高阶图切换为 shared/global-memory buffered two-kernel pipeline。后者重新引入 buffer traffic、kernel boundary 与同步成本；路由阈值和收益没有被证明可迁移到其他 GPU、其他递归图或通用 LLM kernel。
new_exact_v1_reviews.coexistence_boundary: The older path remains appropriate where its workload and SLO do not trigger the changed constraint; the paper is treated as a conditional branch, not a universal replacement.
new_exact_v1_reviews.books_disposition: Rejected — Low Durability / Out of Scope
